notes.title: Korean Support, Update, and Nintendo Switch™ Version Released!
notes.content:
⬜️ Be the Tofu. ⬜️
Thank you for always playing "The Strongest TOFU".
We have a few announcements for everyone.

📛 "The Strongest TOFU" Korean Language Support Added 📛
We have officially released the Korean language version, which has been highly requested.
We are deeply grateful to the many Korean users who have played the game and "become a TOFU" even before the language was officially supported.
With our thanks, we have successfully completed full localization for TOFU.
Please enjoy the soft and moist, simple controls in Korean as well!

📛 TOFU is also available on Nintendo Switch 📛
https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000092740
The Nintendo Switch version of "The Strongest TOFU" was released in February of this year. This is also thanks to all of you who became a TOFU on Steam.
The Korean language support is, of course, also available on the Nintendo Switch version.
If you're interested, please try becoming a TOFU on Nintendo hardware as well!

📛 Update 📛
Bugs that were temporarily fixed only in the Nintendo Switch version have now been fixed in the Steam version with this update.

📛 Streaming Guidelines 📛
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2408680/view/4661878509005241874
The streaming guidelines published in the Steam community also apply when streaming on Nintendo Switch.
In that case, please also follow the guidelines published by Nintendo.
Thank you for your continued support of The Strongest TOFU.
Be the Tofu.

notes.title: 【Update】1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixed a phenomenon in which videos do not play when playing on SteamDeck.
Fixed a phenomenon in which the behavior becomes slow when playing some movies.
The version information has been added to the title screen.
Fixed a phenomenon in which the goal status is not reset when retrying some stages.
The staff roll has been partially revised.

notes.title: Update that may have fixed the bug that made Tofu bounce unbelievably
notes.content:
I was watching the delivery with a grin on my face in the middle of the night when the incident occurred.

Apparently, there was a serious bug in some environments that caused Tofu to jump unbelievably when moving, severely damaging the gameplay. Moreover, we had no idea how to reproduce the bug, which was very troubling.

However, the developers found a suspicious code and probably succeeded in fixing it. No, I have not been able to confirm that it was exactly cured, but I believe it probably was.
